name: language_name
description: Expand common two-letter language codes into English language names; matched control copies the code.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
mapping=dict(zip('en fr es de it zh ja ru pt nl ko tr'.split(),'English French Spanish German Italian Chinese Japanese Russian Portuguese Dutch Korean Turkish'.split()))
items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(96):
 code=list(mapping)[i%len(mapping)]; noun=random.choice(['document','book','article','message'])
 stem=f'The {noun} has ISO 639-1 language code "{code}". '
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'The English name of this language is','answer':' '+mapping[code]})
 controls.append({'prompt':stem+'The two-letter code is','answer':' '+code})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
